summary: Frees three singly-linked lists rooted at this offsets 0x0, 0x4 and 0x8. Each node carries its next pointer at node offset 0x1C (node[7]). For each non-null head, the list is walked, every node is released via EmptyStub_7470 then FreeWrapper_7bcf, and the head is nulled afterwards. Used as part of DirectX object teardown.

operations.description: Load the first list head from this[0] into the traversal pointer.
Guard on the first head (this[0]) being non-null; a null head skips that list entirely.
Walk the first list while the current node's next pointer (node offset 0x1C, node[7]) is non-null, advancing to it after each release.
Invoke EmptyStub_7470 on each node being released before freeing it.
Release each node through FreeWrapper_7bcf, including the final node of the list.
Null the first list head this[0] after its list is fully freed.
Guard on the second head (this[4]) being non-null before traversing and freeing the second list.
Walk the second list while each node's next pointer (node offset 0x1C) is non-null, releasing every node with EmptyStub_7470 and FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Null the second list head this[4] after its list is fully freed.
Guard on the third head (this[8]) being non-null before traversing and freeing the third list.
Walk the third list while each node's next pointer (node offset 0x1C) is non-null, releasing every node with EmptyStub_7470 and FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Null the third list head this[8] after its list is fully freed.
Called by ResourceCleanupDestructionForDirectXObjects (0x00543BF0) to tear down three related object lists at DirectX resource cleanup.

clean_pseudocode: while (node[7]) { _DWORD *nxt = node[7]; EmptyStub_7470(node); FreeWrapper_7bcf(node); node = nxt; }
